prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions tended to overestimate positive impact overall (especially in rounds 1, 2, and 5), but underestimated gains in winning tests during rounds 3 and 4.
home wait_info changes can be helpful, backed by 2 agreeing winning tests in rounds 3 and 4.
sign_in hint changes mostly show no clear effect across 3 agreeing tests (rounds 1, 2, and 5), despite yielding one winning test in round 4.
choose_path layout changes showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests (rounds 1 and 5).
Evidence remains thin for adoption redesign and finish new_screen because their respective tests do not agree.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path copy, choose_path new_flow, finish copy, finish new_flow, home notification, and sign_in reorder, as each has only one test so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -2.1% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +3.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: +0.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, new_flow: -5.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, copy: -1.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: -1.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -4.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, notification: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +1.6% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +1.7% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -7.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 66.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.6%

"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Desktop Waiting Animated Tip Carousel: Adds an interactive tip carousel to the waiting screen that cycles through pet interaction tips every 10 seconds while rendering. (why: The median home wait time is 201s (mean 2336s); keeping users engaged with tips during render reduces drop-off.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Home Intro Controls Demonstration Screen: Adds a dedicated preview screen right after home intro showing an animated video demonstration of how to speak with and control the pet. (why: Support receives multiple tickets regarding post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide desktop pets.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Late Sign-In Flow After Pet Adoption: Moves the sign-in step after adoption certificate creation so users fall in love with their pet before creating an account. (why: Sign-in drop-off happens early at 77.3%; deferring account creation until after pet customization boosts sign-in motivation.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Adoption Photo Calibration Audio Sub-Flow: Introduces a photo calibration sub-flow screen with audio feedback during custom pet creation. (why: Custom pet generation fails or confuses users (3 support emails); providing visual audio calibration feedback improves perception during custom pet setup.)
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Render Countdown Timer: Adds an explicit estimated countdown timer component on the render waiting screen. (why: Home waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s; countdown timer indicators reduce uncertainty and drop-off.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Safety Mascot Warning Reassurance: Displays a mascot and reassuring copy explaining that signing in prevents pet loss or account resets. (why: 8 support emails were received regarding missing or reset pets after signing in.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Render Background Notification Prompt: Enables OS notification opt-in copy on the waiting screen so users can safely minimize the app while waiting. (why: Waiting step takes 201s median time; background notifications prevent app abandonment during long desktop pet rendering.)
7: [finish, incentive] Home Intro Fanfare Celebration Badge: Displays an official readiness badge and celebratory sound effect when reaching the final home intro screen. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8%; rewarding completion encourages users to spawn the pet onto the desktop.)

scores.note: home wait_info changes are proven winners across past rounds, mitigating long render wait times.
Finish step dropoff and support complaints align, but adding new screens at finish historically hurts conversion.
Reordering sign-in flow showed severe drop in previous test (-7.0%) despite reasonable drop-off rationale.
Adoption step has high drop-off and support tickets, but extra sub-flows/screens tend to decrease completion.
Strong positive precedent for home wait_info modifications helping address long waiting times.
Strong evidence from 8 support emails and sign-in dropoff, though hint changes historically show modest gains.
Low cost config prompt, but previous test for home notification showed slight negative impact.
Targets the highest drop-off step (finish: 35.2% loss) with low-friction celebration polish.
